eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Comanche, OK; at 2:21 PM on AUG 29, 2026 Effective until 4:21 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
At 4pm (1600)  a large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control east of Indiahoma and spreading rapidly northward. Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY to to the north towards Cache. Those between Cache Road/Holsey Acres Road and Rogers Lane to the north and south and NW Big Bow Road and NW 197th Street  should LEAVE this area NOW to avoid injury or death. Do not delay to pack belongings. Reunification Center is setting up at the New Life Assembly of God at 501 W B Ave  Cache  OK.
Roads in the area may be impacted by fire and smoke. Never drive into heavy smoke. SLOW DOWN & MOVE OVER for emergency vehicles.
